title: Jamaican Curry Chicken
description: A spicy and flavorful dish made with marinated chicken cooked in a rich Jamaican curry sauce. Serve with rice or roti for a delicious meal.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine curry powder, curry leaves, garlic, ginger, salt, and black pepper. Blend until smooth.
In a large skillet, heat curry oil over medium-high heat. Add chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Add blended spice mixture to the skillet and stir to coat chicken evenly.
Add chopped onion to the skillet and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add hot sauce (if using) and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 10-12 minutes or until chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot with rice or roti, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro (if desired).
